notes.title: Glory Room Update 2023/05/17
notes.content:
Glory Room Update 2023/05/17

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/c3cd30485fd293b59313d8d94aa7a72b218c02b5.gif

1. Character skill Update
Character skills have been added to suit the character's characteristics.
Experience points obtained by clearing rooms or killing monsters
You can get skill points, and you can use coins and skill points to
Each tech can be upgraded.
Character skills are given unique additional effects when mastered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/c6222a89b75cda1e7d4ef50e74849536aa63d905.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/378ae3004ad692165f69101537792626274ad63b.gif

2. Passive and optional skill balance fixes
As the character's skills are added, some of the existing skills
Balance has been adjusted.

3. Increased weapon drop rate
The probability of high tier weapons appearing has been greatly increased.

4. Strengthen the stats of monsters and bosses
As the character's skill is added, the existing monsters
HP increased by 20-75%, attack power increased by 10-25%.

5. Increased number of items in the shop
The maximum number of items that can appear in the shop has been increased to 20.
It has doubled the number previously appearing.
You can also purchase many items through character skills.

notes.title: Glory Room Update date notice 2023/05/05
notes.content:
Add character skill

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/d3f88f6de50a2c328ed4438400a860c7d5f243b0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/93087214f9fb5d9f51f11fc0a911228336d4668d.png

- Depending on the monster's level, gain experience.
- Getting skill points according to the amount of experience.
- 9 skills are added per character to suit the character's characteristics.
- If master the skill, additional special abilities are granted.

Specific key binding

- Due to several overlapping keystrokes, it is not possible to bind all input keys at once. However, the most important key in the current play is "Dodge", and it was judged that depending on the person, it may feel uncomfortable.
Therefore, we plan to temporarily update "Dodge" to allow multiple key types to be selected.
In addition, we will update it so that you can set key bindings for all keystrokes that work through additional updates in the future.

Expected date of update (2023/05/16 ~ 2023/05/20)

notes.title: Update date notice
notes.content:
The update date for Glory Room is April 25, which will be updated about 3 days later than expected.
The main update content is the addition of 3 stages.

Stage 3 is a cave dungeon, a dark and cave-like stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/e26546a3ca82aa9656d330e49dee92616f953b66.gif

3 new monsters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/52cf5e9bbbe89a894f9b8c4f1fd5098dbe1bf8a2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/dd1e5ab6d860a2760d06ee88a981c2f6c4039624.png

- Ghoul
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/505c5ef6b516333409f5f37168ae25d8856226a2.gif

Ghouls are fast, hard, and have stunning attacks.
However, the attack speed is slow and short.

- Toxic Larva

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/0b9a35151c574013aebea926b09ca70bd1de1d7b.gif

Toxic Larva is slow and blunt, but has powerful toxic blast attacks.

- Soulless

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/925c34acdf50d7c0e4ff20ff9175d8497187d695.gif

The Soulless is a powerful monster that has high HP and fires bloodshot cannons in front of it.

2 new trap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/b74a2e5fe8366292bb3fdacd33bcd7af8d910ded.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/fee856badcc78dc9ba6ef8fde7c0c1ed17385671.png

- Steel Fist

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/141bb85141f051f41c8b669e5e638001b1d61517.gif

Steel Fist is a trap that inflicts a stun attack in a wide area.

- Pendulum Axe

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43791723/b7fc76971c72db0843c6488f4b4acbaaf11f0b86.gif

The Pendulum Axe continuously attacks and pushes the character to the edge of a cliff.
